name: Isleton Bridge
facts: Built in 1923, Isleton Bridge showcases a 226‑foot Strauss bascule span designed by Sacramento County engineer Charles W. Deterding and the Strauss Bascule Bridge Company of Chicago.
The bridge features two 102‑foot concrete tied‑arch spans to the east of the main bascule, plus four sturdy concrete girder spans, all supporting California State Route 160.
Steel components were fabricated by the American Bridge Company, while Jenkins & Elton of Sacramento executed the construction, blending engineering precision with local craftsmanship.
